source.author: lucan
source.text: Sic longius aevum Destruit ingentes animos, et vita superstes Imperio.
source.text_original: Sic longius aevum / Destruit ingentes animos, et vita superstes / Imperio.
source.text_english: Thus prolonged age destroys great spirits, and life surviving its empire.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: est etiam ante oculos aevi rudis altera proles, ingentes animos et fortia discere facta quem velit atque olim leti meminisse paterni.
reuse.text_original: est etiam ante oculos aevi rudis altera proles, / ingentes animos et fortia discere facta / quem velit atque olim leti meminisse paterni.
reuse.text_english: There is also before the eyes of the untutored age another offspring, one whom it may wish to learn great spirits and brave deeds, and later to remember its father’s death.
